risk: Because MFA is not enforced for all remote access, stolen credentials could allow an attacker to sign in remotely, resulting in data theft or ransomware
action: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for all remote access and admins

risk: Because backups are reachable from the production domain, ransomware could encrypt backups too, resulting in extended outage and data loss
action: Add immutable/offline backup copy and separate backup credentials

risk: Because third-party suppliers are not assessed, a supplier breach could expose customer data, resulting in regulatory and contractual impact
action: Introduce tiered vendor security assessment (see vendor assessment template)

risk: Because patching of internet-facing systems has no SLA, a known vulnerability could be exploited before it is fixed, resulting in compromise of the perimeter
action: Define SLA (critical: 7 days, exploited in the wild: 48 hours) and track exceptions

risk: Because staff receive no regular phishing training, a user could enter credentials on a fake login page, resulting in account takeover
action: Quarterly phishing simulations and a one-click report button

risk: Because no one owns the asset inventory, unknown systems could remain unpatched and unmonitored, resulting in blind spots for attackers to use
action: Assign owner; automate discovery from EDR/CMDB/cloud APIs
